capabilities: Import papers from arXiv IDs or URLs with metadata and PDF download
Import local PDFs and extract title, authors, date, and abstract
Generate AI reading sections (idea, method, limitations, future work) via Claude Code or Codex
Add exact-match PDF++ highlights with configurable concepts and colors
Customize generated notes with a custom template file
extras: AI reading requires Obsidian desktop because it runs local CLI tools; metadata import and PDF download also work on mobile. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import arXiv papers with metadata, PDFs, and AI-generated reading notes in one step.
